mapper.select: SELECT e.*, s.name AS student_name, c.name AS course_name FROM student_course_enrollment e LEFT JOIN student s ON e.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.id ORDER BY e.id DESC
SELECT e.*, s.name AS student_name, c.name AS course_name FROM student_course_enrollment e LEFT JOIN student s ON e.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.id WHERE e.id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM student_course_enrollment WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_course_enrollment WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_course_enrollment (student_id, course_id, order_id, parent_id, status, enroll_time) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{courseId}, #{orderId}, #{parentId}, #{status}, #{enrollTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE student_course_enrollment SET status = 0 WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 1
